brief: Full redesign and rebrand replacing the textbook 3-ring atom with the Catalyst Hexagon / Molecular Prism, adopting Solar Precision Laboratory color palette (Solar Amber and Electric Cobalt on Carbon Obsidian).

concepts.name: The Catalyst Hexagon
concepts.idea: An organic chemistry benzene hexagon fusing letters 'C' and 'K' with a central catalytic prism core.
rationale: Eliminates the generic 3-orbit atom cliché in favor of rigorous hexagonal molecular geometry.
Left facet forms the letter 'C' (Chemistry/Carbon), while the vertical spine and right branches form the letter 'K' (Kit/Kinetic).
Central prism node represents catalytic energy and computational precision.
Scales effortlessly down to 16px favicon and up to high-resolution vector signage.

recommendation: The Catalyst Hexagon establishes an unmistakable, sharp identity that feels engineered and professional while immediately communicating chemistry.
